Author: github-actions[bot]
Message:
ci(release): self-driving ceremony — push-triggered, PAT pushes, auto-merge

- release.yml now runs on push to main (concurrency-serialized), so every
  merge automatically runs release-please and merges + publishes release PRs.
- Prepare step pushes the release branch with RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN instead of
  GITHUB_TOKEN: bot-triggered CI is suppressed by GitHub, so the release PR
  showed 'no checks reported' and branch protection blocked every merge.
- New step enables gh pr merge --auto on the release PR after preparation;
  the auto-merge completes when checks pass, and the merge push re-triggers
  the workflow to create releases + publish.
- AGENTS.md: document the ceremony + the release-please blind spot for
  non-squashed merges (e.g. 524798f BYOK was invisible to release-please).

Message:
feat(cli): auth login method menu + OAuth pre-flight probe

- Interactive menu (browser / paste token / cancel) - never opens a
  browser without user choice
- probeOAuthConfig pre-flights /auth/cli (redirect: manual) and warns
  on empty client_id instead of opening a broken GitHub OAuth page
- --token <t> non-interactive login (validated via /api/ide/me);
  --provider github|google passthrough
- Hidden token paste via promptHidden (readline muted echo)
- warnEnvTokenShadow: flags leftover ASTRIVYA_TOKEN env var that
  shadows stored credentials (root cause of 401 on cloud commands)
- Tests: parseLoginChoice, probeOAuthConfig, runTokenLogin (11 new)
